landing.heroSubtitle: Sessio replaces WhatsApp scheduling for sports schools. Automatic confirmations, instant backfill when someone cancels, and a clear overview — so you coach more and admin less.
landing.featuresSubtitle: Everything you need to run group trainings — without the daily back-and-forth.
landing.feature1Desc: Participants are enrolled by default. If they can't make it, they cancel in one tap. No more chasing replies on WhatsApp.
landing.feature2Desc: When someone cancels, nearby athletes get notified and can claim the spot. No more sitting idle at the venue.
landing.feature3Desc: See who's coming, who cancelled, and how full each session is. Attendance, waitlist, groups — one place.
landing.feature4Desc: Share a link. Participants sign up in 30 seconds — straight from the browser.
landing.stepsSubtitle: Your participants can join right away.
landing.step1Desc: Set the sport, time, location, and number of spots.
landing.step2Desc: Share a link or join code. People sign up in seconds.
landing.step3Desc: Confirmations, reminders, backfill, and attendance — all automatic.
landing.ctaSubtitle: No credit card. No complicated setup. Start with your current participants.
